alfalfa.calculation: 111 - (8 parcels * 50 USD / 400 acres) - 10 ditch maintenance = 100 USD/acre water component, in 2008 dollars.
alfalfa.interpretation: Only the 100 USD water component would be replaced if water.json charges water purchase alone; preserve 1 parcel fee and 10 ditch maintenance. Still requires a common money-year and farm match.
alfalfa.caveat: Publisher HTML Table 2 is incorrectly captioned wine grapes; body and table describe alfalfa. Do not call original PDF verified.

barley.interpretation: The 56 USD/acre is power. Do not remove it when replacing only purchased-water cost; well/pivot budget is not a gravity-delivery Fallon budget.
barley.caveat: Malting barley premium and production system do not match generic feed barley automatically.

dry_beans.interpretation: Table 2 shows total cost 999 and a water-only line 85; irrigation labor remains in labor costs. Nominal 2008 dollars.
dry_beans.caveat: Commodity includes lima/blackeye types; match species and contemporary market before use.

safflower.interpretation: Table 2 shows total cost 350 and water 11; amounts are rounded 2011-dollar table values, not current quotes.

cover_crop.interpretation: Tables 1/2 show 156 operating cost, including 22 water and 22 irrigation labor. Retain labor. Not a full ownership-cost budget.
cover_crop.caveat: Vetch/pea/rye mix has a nitrogen credit; do not assign it to sole cereal rye.

wheat.interpretation: Local refetch of the USU PDF returned 403; leave unverified in this run. Cannot split water versus power/labor from an annual label alone.
